entries.0d11d1432bcd00b8: This region covers the United States, Brazil and others. In the corporate business, new security investment was suppressed by uncertainty over the outlook for U.S. trade policy and others, and the consumer business was also affected by changes to sales channels. The U.S. subsidiary serves as a base for research and development and sales, and its revenue exceeds 10% of consolidated revenue. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥55,187 million.
entries.15ee7cc05118d51f: This region covers Taiwan, Australia, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates and others. Backed by Vision One, next-generation SOC-related security using AI made a significant contribution, and email-related security also grew, with the Middle East, Taiwan and Singapore driving sales. The Taiwan subsidiary serves as a base for research and development and sales. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥71,516 million.

entries.d20062c2a2e34884: It sets as its vision the realization of 'a world where digital information can be exchanged safely'. As its medium- to long-term strategy, it lists providing the integrated security platform 'Trend Vision One', which uses AI technology, deploying a broad range of solutions from threat prediction to countermeasures after intrusion, and promoting a hybrid configuration that supports both SaaS and on-premises models. It also indicates that it aims to continuously increase ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue).

entries.f1edeac3c0652d80: The company has a structure in which both development and sales are dispersed across the world: R&D is shared by the company in Japan and subsidiaries in the United States, Ireland and Australia, and sales are handled by subsidiaries in the Americas, Europe and Asia Pacific. A distinguishing feature is that it provides products and services to both corporate and individual customers, centered on the integrated platform 'Trend Vision One'.
